rules.statement: When a package adds a dependency-injection registration extension (an `Add…Library()`-style method on `IServiceCollection`), give its own test project a registration test that calls it on a new `ServiceCollection` and checks that each registered service resolves with the expected lifetime and implementation (keyed or named services by key).
rules.why: If a registration drops a service or wires it wrong, only distant downstream or integration tests would catch it, not the tests of the package that owns it.
rules.check: Look for new or changed `Add…` registration extension methods in a diff whose package test project has no test calling them directly, while sibling packages do have DefaultRegistrationTests.

rules.statement: Wrap new or edited code comments to the line width the rest of the file uses (about 120 columns), not as one long line.
rules.why: An unwrapped comment of a couple of hundred characters doesn't match the file's style and is harder to read.
rules.check: Look for added comment lines far longer than the file's other lines, for example over 120 characters.
